_comment: Maps an equipped weapon (RpgItemDefinition) -> melee animation family -> humanoid.anim clips. Rules evaluate top-down on weapon.damageType + weapon.properties, first match wins; weaponOverrides beat rules; no weapon equipped = unarmedFamily. Clip-side metadata (meleeFamily/meleeRole/hitFrameFraction) lives in '# clip_meta:' headers in humanoid.anim, written by tools/anim_pipeline/generate_melee.py. This file lives in an anim/ subdirectory so RpgItemRegistry's *.json directory glob does not try to parse it as an item.
_comment_speed: attackSpeedRange clamps the playback rate when the engine scales swings (e.g. by weapon speed or haste). Light-property weapons may run toward the top of the band, Heavy toward the bottom.
_comment_overrides: spear has no Reach property in 5e (it is Thrown+Versatile) but should clearly use the spear thrust; quarterstaff swings read better as two-handed sweeps. Bows fall back to unarmed until a ranged family exists.
